response: Older men can benefit from curative therapy of localized prostate cancer, particularly if they have few comorbidities and moderately or poorly differentiated cancer. Age should not be a barrier to treatment in this group, as potentially curative therapy can result in significantly improved life expectancy (LE) and quality-adjusted life expectancy (QALE). However, it's essential to consider individual factors, such as overall health and specific quality-of-life aspects, when making treatment decisions.
